title: Apocalyptic Cosmic Vision
description: A surreal apocalyptic scene depicts a golden armored angel with white wings and a blue-robed wizard holding a staff standing on a rocky peak. To the right lies a hellish landscape of blackened dead trees, lava flows, bones, and tentacles, while the sky features a massive flaming eye, a purple geometric sphere with skulls, a spaceship, and a ringed planet against a fiery red and teal nebula.
